description_en: Retrieves backup records of an ApsaraDB for HBase cluster by calling DescribeBackups
description_zh: 通过DescribeBackups获取hbase集群备份记录信息
kebab_example: aliyun hbase describe-backups --cluster-id hb-t4naqsay5gn0000 --backup-id job-xxxx --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --start-time 2020-12-13_00:00:00 --end-time 2020-12-23_23:59:59 --start-time-utc 2020-12-12T16:00:00Z --end-time-utc 2020-12-23T15:59:59Z --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackups

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup to query
parameters.name: backup_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the backup query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.help_zh: 查询备份的开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the backup query. Format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.help_zh: 查询备份的结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The start time of the backup query in UTC. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.help_zh: 查询备份的开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time_utc

parameters.help_en: The end time of the backup query in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ
parameters.help_zh: 查询备份的结束时间，必须晚于查询开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: end_time_utc
